tree: EP40 20+60 ordinary rank recipe, fold medians, seed 4002, remove all 9 market_ columns from the tree only
universe: original PIT-asof historical CSI300 membership proxy and EP40 signal eligibility
selection: K=floor(N/10), m=floor(K/5); rank by Ridge, replace lowest tree-ranked m of R top K with highest tree-ranked m of R ranks K+1 through 2K; ties high security code first
weights: equal target weights per sleeve, actual opening fills and legacy untradeable holdings
capital: 10 sleeves each initially one tenth; offset 0 through 9; before first trade hold cash; internal cross before fees
training: quarterly expanding, previous-quarter mature weekly H10 outcomes only
review: first 12 mature new H10 for attribution and 24 for directional review. No pre-entry timestamped forward records in this historical evaluation
